lines: Heberyone was really lucky to win against her that time.
She was really showing off the "made to destroy demons" part.
With the blade she wielded, Clear blew the scarecrows and poltergeists away.
『Hnngh～!!? Why is our Clear-chan helping that boy Fuma!?』
The unseen butler of the Netherworld was apparently confused by the unexpected help we received.
『Hah!? Is it possible that you seduced the pure Clear-chan into helping you!? Hnngh... I cannot forgive this!!!』
『That damn Fuma boy!! Not only Miss Yukikaze, he even got Clear-chan and her cute small bosomー』
Once more the group of scarecrows were blown away in place of the butler who had created an incomprehensible misunderstanding.
N-Nice!! Anyway now is our chance, let's rush to Clear's room!!
After shaking off the scarecrows and poltergeists chasing us, we managed to arrive.
Here. My room. I closed door. So good for now.
Thank you, Clear. ...Well now, this is a really nice room huh.
I spoke as I looked around the room.
Clear's room was a girly one, filled to the brim with cute stuffed animals that were all lined up.
Clear had a happy yet bashful look on her face.
Did someone buy you these stuffed animals too?
Yes. Old man and Yukikaze. Buy everything to me.
As you could expect from someone rich living in such a castle.
Apparently, Clear was treated extremely well, even spoiled.
Fuma. Come play next time. Let's play frisbee again. Okay?
Oh, yeah, okay. I'll come. I know where you live now.
Hey, that's not fair to invite only Fuma-chan! Clear-chan, can Hebiko come too?
Aaaah～! Me too, me too!! I want to come and play with Clear-chan too!
For real? Then we need to add Yukikaze as well and find some game that we can play with the five of us.
We were surrounding the smiling Clear in a friendly atmosphere.
ーHowever, we couldn't just stay here like this.
From outside of Clear's room we could hear banging on the door followed by some weird laughs.
It seemed that the group of scarecrows had followed us to this room.
Yukikaze's room at end of hall.
Use door there. Straight and right.
Clear pointed at the end of the room. There was a door, different from the one we had used to come in.
...Got it! The end of the hall down the corridor to the right.
Clear looked at the door we entered from and prepared her blade.
The door was creaking furiously on the verge of being destroyed.
No problem. Clear is strong enough to fight evenly against Yukikaze.
On top of that, that ghost butler seemed to be smitten with Clear.
It was extremely unlikely that Clear would end up hurt.
Alright, we're going! We're counting on you, Clear!!
